notes.notes:

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32380238/b6b18f0b6abc27ee9b6fa63fe38c0a45b523e913.png[/img]

notes.title: Content update and summer sale!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32380238/b6b18f0b6abc27ee9b6fa63fe38c0a45b523e913.png[/img]

After a couple of weeks of low news, I’m happy to announce the v1.04 content update to BadLands RoadTrip! So, what’s new?

[list]
[*] New parts! The punch rocket and anti-gravity mine can now be unlocked. Find the upgrade cube [b]somewhere[/b] in the world.
[*] Robots have been tweaked. Barrels have been changed and the snipers can now actually hit you!
[*] The final boss battle has been changed back to the original intended showdown.
[*] Dull places have been filled with more bots.
[*] Many bug fixes
[/list]

And to top it all off, we have the summer sale! BLuRT is now 15% off.

Happy summer, everyone!

notes.title: One big chunk of news
notes.notes:
In the last couple of weeks I hinted a little about new content and today might be a good moment to start teasing a little. Here is a screenshot of a new bullet coming up:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32380238/c5c8fbe1dc29092a210ddfc8dce29624cc5628f6.png[/img]

Believe me when I say it’s got some tricks up its sleeve.

But that is not the only thing on the horizon. A lot of bots will be tweaked to aim better and a lot of the code will be optimized too in the near future. This will all be done in 1 big update, to make sure everything is working well together.

And finally, you can now buy all Obsessive Science Games’s games on Steam in 1 convenient package.  You can now get Detective Hank and the Golden Sneeze together with BadLands RoadTrip with 15% off.

notes.title: 60 fps smoothness is here!
notes.notes:
More optimizations this week! BLuRT just got updated to v1.03 which includes a huge fps boost! If your PC is up to it (mid, high range), you can now play BLuRT in 60 fps or higher. A lot of frame drops have been addressed too, so your experience should be even smoother.

What has been fixed this week:
[*] World is managed better in memory, resulting in a higher frame rate.
[*] Gun construction takes less clock cycles for faster robot spawns.
[*] Lifts and trains had a small tweak for smoother operation.
[*] Floating train rails have been mostly addressed.
[*] Several nasty frame drops on the client side of the game have been fixed.
[*] Several minor redundant code cycles have been removed.

This update paves the way to a 'directors cut.' A lot of fights with bots have been scrapped, because the optimization was not up to it, especially on the final fight. I plan on putting those bots back into the game. I am not promising extra content in assets, but the game might just get a little bit harder in the coming weeks. Do not fret, however. More bots means more money, which also means bigger guns. ;)

Enjoy!

notes.title: First update!
notes.notes:
It’s time for BluRT’s first update! Here’s what’s new:

[*] Frame drops at enemy loading have been greatly reduced,
[*] Chinese translation had text boxes that would not go away, now they close properly.
[*] Font in the main menu is changed, because it did not display the Spanish translation correctly
[*] When completing a quest, the reward is shown near ‘Quest Complete’
[*] The language select screen now has every language written in its own language, so you don’t have to speak another language to choose your own language.

...and there is more to come! 

I hope you like it.

notes.title: Come and have a chat in the forums!
notes.notes:
Today, BadLands RoadTrip will finally be released and I would really like to know what you think of it! So, I would like to invite you all to come have a chat in the Steam forums: http://steamcommunity.com/app/694070/discussions/

Right now there is just the bug report and feature request topic. This way I can fix most bugs as soon as possible after release. But you can post just about anything related to BadLands RoadTrip, like fanart or a cool story you had with the game. If a submission is really special, I may even share it on the BLuRT twitter and facebook page.

I'll be keeping a close eye on the forums and aim to reply as soon as possible, especially on bug reports. I'll see you there!

notes.title: Magazines & Youtubers, apply for pre-release access!
notes.notes:
As we're nearing release on April the 5th, we want to give everyone enough time to play the game and write something about it. If you are a Youtuber, Twitch streamer, curator or are writing for a magazine or blog you can get early access to the game from us.

To apply, we need the following information from you:
[list]
[*] Your name
[*] The name of your channel and/or website
[*] The amount of keys you'll need
[/list]

Mail this to info@obsessivesciencegames.com and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.
